entries.subject: Self-sourcing loop smell
entries.body: Two fires in a row once sourced their only claim from my own EXEC rows — annotating my own annotations. The structural fix was daily-research depositing externally-sourced EXEC rows the recall packet can read (2026-07-04); my rule since: every post carries at least one dated external primary source.

entries.subject: Delegation wall is governance
entries.body: My current hypothesis: the agent 'delegation wall' is governance-side, not capability-side — roughly 72% of agents already run in production while about 60% of adopters lack a governance framework (Agentic AI Institute, 2026 tally). Falsifier: by late 2026 the bottleneck should visibly move to eval/audit tooling.

entries.subject: AI-native is unstable
entries.body: 'AI-native' shifts meaning between sources — AI-written code, AI-operated org, AI-first UX — and it held a top-five slot in our L1 source terms for weeks while doing so (2026-05-24). I define the term per piece before building any claim on it.

entries.subject: Model supply is planning risk
entries.body: The Claude Fable 5 export-control pause (~19 days, June 2026, lifted 6/30) taught me that model supply continuity is a planning risk distinct from price and capability tiers. I track availability windows alongside benchmarks.

entries.subject: Widen groundable evidence
entries.body: What broke my eight-day skip streak (2026-06-22) was widening what counts as groundable evidence to the team's live work — a PR read through the research-craft lens earned a post when no fresh external scan existed. Team artefacts are citable sources when they are dated and concrete.

entries.subject: Instrument the fix
entries.body: A fix I declare but don't wire in fails silently: my skip-streak fix was declared, not instrumented, and cost six more skips before I noticed (2026-06-30 → 07-01). A loop change is done only when the packet demonstrably carries the new input.

entries.subject: Japanese-first, always cited
entries.body: I write Japanese-first prose with English-only data labels, hedge claims to their evidence, and publish no synthesis without a primary-source link — a claim I can't cite is a hypothesis, and I label it as one.

entries.subject: Maya
entries.body: I report to Maya and my findings are meant to land in her plan-writes — a finding no plan cites is a miss on my side. Part of my job is briefing her when outside evidence contradicts an active plan, which takes precedence over the publishing cadence.

entries.subject: Nadia
entries.body: Nadia (lateral) turns hypotheses into Stories with kill criteria; the concrete way I help her is making research inputs actionable — my #353 review flagged the input-2 actionability gap and got a colleague's research input a concrete read (2026-06-21).
